line: LANE-ODDS 2026-07-30: p_bust / p_star grade-basis gate (re-key vs the pin).

frame.pool: xfv_{hitter,pitcher}_matrix.json minus (kind=bust AND bust_recent), prepped on target_censored (efv_score.run's own pool + target)
frame.test_restriction: censored is False AND target_resolved numeric
frame.why_not_2021_plus: the 6-season window has not closed, so every resolved row in 2021-2024 is a bust by construction (base rate 1.000) and cannot test a probability

labels.bust: target_resolved / 6 < 0.5 WAR per season (< 3.0 total). SHIPPED definition, tools/_prem_odds.py:41; band from value_framework_config.yaml:38 buckets.bust.band '<0.5'.
labels.star: target_resolved / 6 >= 4.0 WAR per season (>= 24.0 total). Same five-bucket ladder, value_framework_config.yaml:42 buckets.star.band '4.0+'. NOT the star_odds model's definition.
labels.star_power_caveat: declared UNPOWERED in the pre-registration: the frame holds 9 hitter stars and 2 pitcher stars.

arms.C_zeroinfo: constant at the fold's TRAINING base rate (climatology)
arms.D_twin_rankB: B's ranking carrying A's marginal (rank-identical twin of B)
arms.F_pin_platt: A after a nested forward-chained Platt map
arms.G_rekey_platt: B after a nested forward-chained Platt map

sign_convention: d = metric(A_pin) - metric(B_rekey); POSITIVE d means the RE-KEY is better.
ship_criterion: re-key ships only if B beats A on Brier AND logloss on BOTH sides, and the paired refit bootstrap CI95 excludes zero on the pooled cut for both metrics; plus the level-shift trap (1.7.3) and the twin rule (1.7.4).
caveats: The D/E twins are quantile-matched on the FULL per-side frame; on the served-comparable SUBSET the match is therefore approximate. The primary cuts are exact.
F/G carry no Platt map on fold 2014 (no prior out-of-fold rows to fit one), where they fall back to A/B unchanged.
Per-fold Platt maps make F and G globally non-monotone transforms of A and B, so their AUC is not preserved; the proper scores are the quantities of interest there.
